Name: Twenty One Pilots Secret Woods Ned
Author: rrafff
Description:
[center]Inspired by LorSnore's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2927]Secret Woods Totoro[/url]﻿, this mod replaces Old Master Cannoli graphics and text with Ned from Twenty One Pilots. Give Ned a Sweet Gem Berry and see his big smile!


[u]Configuration
[/u]
[size=2][/size]After loading the mod once, you can set the winter leaf pile to "Dead"(default) or "Blue" in the config.json

Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI.


[u]Credits

[/u][url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/sarahkik.612721/]SarahKik[/url]﻿ - for the original Totoro artwork
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2927]LorSnore[/url]﻿ - for the inspiration and almost everything else (including the files of their mod)
[url=https://aminoapps.com/c/clique/page/user/motse/BQQm_wgRcbf5WV25KW7dl7gqZRblrj1pl3K]motse[/url]﻿ - for the Ned pixelart that I used as a base for my design (I asked them for permission but they went offline 3 years ago - they didn't specify if they allow the use of their art but the website allows it if not specified)[/center]
